description: Returns artists with optional filtering, pagination and sorting. Sub‑methods such as artists/tracks, artists/albums, etc. are available. The method requires a client_id and supports various query parameters to control the result set.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append _asc or _desc to set direction. Ascending is default, except popularity fields which default to descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes 'results_fullcount' – the total number of rows without limit/offset. Use sparingly for performance.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search for artists whose name contains the given substring.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on artist joining date. Format: 'yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd' (from_to).

notes: Do not include the version prefix in the path; use "/artists".
The 'limit' parameter cannot exceed 200 even when set to 'all'.
Popularity‑based order fields always use descending order, ignoring an explicit _asc suffix.
Enabling 'fullcount' may impact performance on heavy queries.
